newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Elec 1996 net up from yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Elec 1996 net up from yr ago.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Electronics Co said on Wednesday its after-tax net profit rose to 48.5 billion won in calendar 1996 from 47.2 billion won in 1995.
The company's annual turnover rose to 3.57 trillion won in 1996 from 3.13 trillion a year ago, a Daewoo spokesman said.
He said its ordinary profit fell to 68 billion won from 82 billion won. But he could not give details.
The official said more details and a breakdown of its income statement would be announced later.
The company is a unit of the Daewoo Group DWGR.CN and one of South Korea's top three consumer electronics makers.
